A working session needs me to occasionally prompt back: “no, ask me the next question.”
Even half-enforced Socratic mode beats plain chat for learning maths.

The same trick should work with a PDF (or any reference document) attached: condition the chatbot on the source material *plus* the Socratic stance, and now we have a tutor that knows the specific text and is restrained from spoiling it.
